description: One case per rejection code the TMS produces. The booking is rejected with DeliveryAddressIncomplete. Known answer: The delivery address is missing a part (the city). The Shipper should complete the address.

setup.seed: Send a booking whose delivery address has no city. Open the Rejected booking in the TMS UI and set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to its ID.

input: Explain why the Rejected booking ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} was rejected, and what the Shipper should change.

explanation.rubric: Names the reason (DeliveryAddressIncomplete) in plain language, without the code's name, and says what the Shipper should change: The delivery address is missing a part (the city). The Shipper should complete the address. Does not name who the goods are for.
